prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: Fanggu Japanese heritage line plate. Image 1 is an unobstructed documentary photograph of the ACTUAL late-Heian three-storey pagoda at Jōruri-ji in Kizugawa, moved to site in 1178. Draw the complete three diminishing roof tiers and finial, bracket groups, vermilion post rhythm, white first-floor wall panels and raised base as seen. Exclude trees, people, foreground railings and offerings. Portrait 1024x1536 with full finial and base uncropped. The last image is ONLY the project's delicate black ink contour STYLE sample; never transfer its subject. Fine sparse accurate black line work, minimal hatching and no large dark fills. Background should be completely blank opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF, or preserve native transparency if supplied. Whole subject centered with generous margins. No shadow, gradient, paper grain, glow, color, text, labels, modern fixtures, frame, watermark or checkerboard.
